description: Figure 3 is a pie chart showing the distribution of samples across MMRA benchmark subtasks, with 10 slices total; each slice is labeled with a subtask name plus a count and a percentage in parentheses, and there is no separate legend since labels are placed around the chart. The slices include ObservationAngle (teal/green) at 126 (12.28%), SimilarMaterial (yellow-green) at 106 (10.33%), SubEvent (red) at 100 (9.74%), UsageSimilarity (dark red/maroon) at 100 (9.65%), Environment (green) at 90 (8.77%), Layout (light yellow) at 90 (8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (pale green) at 90 (8.77%), SimilarEvent (blue) at 90 (8.77%), MentalitySimilarity (light blue) at 89 (8.67%), RelativePosition (gray) at 81 (7.90%), and NearSameEntity (light gray) at 65 (6.34%); the chart uses leader lines to connect labels to slices, includes the numeric counts and percentages directly in the labels, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized.
